'''Cat Miin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] who served as the chief [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Miin traveled with Mai to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where they pledged their allegiance to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a group of star systems who succeeded from the Republic. Shortly afterwards, the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out in a [[Petranaki arena|Geonosis arena]]. Miin stayed by Mai's side throughout the war, and eventually followed her to the planet of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] along with the rest of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], under the orders of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. On Mustafar, the council awaited the arrival of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the new apprentice of the confederate leader, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], believing Vader would protect them during the last stages of the war. Miin was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Vader instead [[Death/Legends|executed]] the Separatists, under Sidious' orders.

==Biography==
[[File:CatMiin_AotC_Res.png|thumb|left|150px|Cat Miin while on Geonosis]]
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]], Cat Miin hailed from [[Castell/Legends|Castell]],<ref name="DB" /> although it was not the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="DB2">{{DB|character|shumai|Mai, Shu}} states that [[Castell/Legends|Castell]] is the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]</ref> Miin began working for the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], where she worked her way up the company ladder until she became the administratress of the guild [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]], [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]],<ref name="DB" /> another female Gossam.<ref name="DB3">{{DB|character|shumai|Mai, Shu}}</ref> As chief [[Aide/Legends|aide]], Miin worked closely with Mai.<ref name="DB" /> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Mai was invited to the planet of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Miin traveled with the Commerce Guild leader, where they secretly conversed with the recently formed [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], led by the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], which was made up of several conglomerate leaders professing their dissatisfaction with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which dominated [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Although Mai knew that siding with the Separatists would be an act of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Republic, she ultimately pledged the support of the Commerce Guild. Ultimately, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was formed, and an event known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted only a little while later when an [[Jedi assault team/Legends|army]] of Jedi arrived at a [[Petranaki arena|Geonosis arena]] and [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|engaged]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces. Both Miin and Mai were able to escape from Geonosis.<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Miin was eventually assigned to overlook the handling of raw materials that were being used to sustain the droid armies of the Separatists, and continued to travel with Mai to many secret meetings and confederate gatherings.<ref name="DB" /> By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Mai was involved in a propaganda project known as the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]], which spread news and information to worlds controlled by the Separatists. Miin was at Mai's side when the Gossam Presidente made an official statement about a [[Battle of Bassadro|battle]] that occurred on the planet of [[Bassadro]], stating that the confederate [[Major/Legends|major]] in charge, [[Domb Treetor]], only surrendered to Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] in order to preserve the lives of civilians. In reality, Treetor had killed numerous civilians in an attempt to wipe out the Republic troops.

During the final year of the war, [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Separatist Council was eventually ordered to hide on the planet of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], where they were to await further instruction from the mysterious confederate leader, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Eventually, the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who had been leading the droid armies throughout the war, arrived on Utapau after the unsuccessful kidnapping of the Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. Grievous was immediately contacted by Sidious upon arrival, and ordered that the Separatist leaders move to the lava world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], which would be safer for them. Grievous relayed the information, much to the frustration of certain council [[Nute Gunray/Legends|members]].<ref name="RotS" />

Miin and Mai, along with the rest of the leaders, obeyed. The [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] occurred shortly after, in which Grievous was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Sidious, who was actually the Republic chancellor, Palpatine, then issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a directive that ordered all Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to execute their Jedi generals. Sidious then ordered his new pupil, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to attend to Mustafar. Sidious explained that with the onset of confederate victory, Vader would protect them as the war finally ended. However, when Vader [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|arrived]], he began to execute the council members, under Sidious' orders.<ref name="RotS" /> Miin was killed by Vader,<ref name="DB" /> while Mai was [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]].

==Personality and traits==
Cat Miin was trusted by Shu Mai, under the fact that Miin was allowed to attend many secretive confederate meetings with Mai, including the meeting where they pledged their allegiance to Dooku.<ref name="DB" /> Otherwise, Miin was often silent, patiently observing Mai's duties.<ref name="RotS" /><ref name="AotC" /> Miin was also entrusted with the observing of deliveries regarding the raw materials needed to create the Separatist's droid armies. Miin had [[Color/Legends|blue]] colored skin, and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with black irises. During 22 BBY, Miin's skin was a light blue color with some hints of a beige color,<ref name="DB" /> but as the war progressed and as Miin grew in age, her skin color notably darkened, and the beige traces disappeared.<ref name="RotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cat Miin was created for a brief appearance in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which was directed by [[George Lucas]]. In ''Clones'', Miin had noticeably different appearance than Shu Mai, including a different head shape, lack of a headdress, and lighter skin. Both Gossam characters were fully generated with computers. Miin later appeared in ''Clones''{{'s}} [[2005]] sequel, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. For her second film appearance, Miin was realized as a re-coloration of the existing Mai graphic. Whereas Mai was seen unchanged from her earlier appearance, her model was given blue clothing and darker skin in order to portray Miin. This version of Miin was used as a basis for an [[action figure]] produced by [[Hasbro]] that was distributed during the release of ''Sith''. Similar to Miin's second film appearance, her first action figure was actually a repaint of an earlier released Shu Mai figure.
